description: Arithmetic in the Wild (arXiv:2605.01148), probe-training harvest: layer-18 output residual at the last token of '{a}+{b}=' addition prompts (a, b in 1..199, the paper's full App. G.1 range), meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B. The golden steering test fits the paper's affine sine/cosine Fourier probes on this harvest (Adam, lr 1e-3, 500 epochs - test-side, since v1 has no Fourier train objective) and steers the hours prompts through a pytorch_fn edit implementing Eq. 4 / Algorithm 1. No lm_head read - the forward elides past layer 18.
